findings.claim: Only generated formatter classes are decorated. Generated resolver classes are left without ExcludeFromCodeCoverage, so the acceptance criterion that all generated code be decorated is not met; the new README wording also narrows the claim to generated formatters.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.GeneratedResolverCoverageAttributeTests.EveryGeneratedSourceFile_HasExcludeFromCodeCoverage. It generates an object formatter and TestResolver, then requires every generated file to contain the attribute. On this change the formatter file passes that assertion but the resolver file does not.

interpretations.label: A
interpretations.summary: Coverage exclusion applies only to generated formatter classes. Keep the conditional attribute in FormatterTemplate, StringKeyFormatterTemplate, EnumTemplate, and UnionTemplate, leave generated resolvers undecorated, and add no setting.

interpretations.label: B
interpretations.summary: All source-generated types are in scope. Apply the same target-conditional ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute to generated resolver classes as well as every formatter variant, with no setting required; an optional opt-out could be added separately.
